payload.reason: The evidence describes the use of a question generation model in the context of knowledge-based machine reading comprehension, where it generates questions based on the semantics of candidate answers and integrates external knowledge.

claims.text: A question generation model is used in knowledge-based machine reading comprehension to generate questions based on the semantics of candidate answers.
The question generation model outputs questions by taking the path between an anchor and a candidate answer.
The model incorporates external knowledge bases to improve the accuracy of question generation and answering.
